name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: April Week 4 - Scratch Variables
description: Practice words for a Scratch score challenge.

words.definition: A coding tool that uses blocks.
words.example: The class used Scratch to make a score game.

words.definition: A character or object in Scratch.
A group of blocks that tells a sprite what to do.
words.example: The script ran when the sprite was clicked.

words.definition: A place in a program that stores something that can change.
The number or information stored in a variable.
words.example: The score value changed from 0 to 1.
The score went up when the player clicked.
The block can change the score when the sprite is clicked.

words.definition: To try something to see if it works.
words.example: The student can test the game after adding a score block.

words.definition: To find why a Scratch project or variable does not work and fix it.
words.example: The student can debug the score problem by checking each block.
